Priyom / Karthik — forwarding Alicia's note and my quick checklist for publisher verification. I27ve kept items tightly scoped to what Azure marketplace and co-sell review typically request. We should drop the CSV as an attachment to Alicia so procurement has a single artifacts list.

Publisher evidence checklist (high level):
- Publisher account: verified tenant ID + publisher registration proof (tenant admin screenshot)
- Manifest: offer/plan JSON, SKU mapping, pricing dimensions
- SPN & RBAC: service principal used for telemetry hooks, proof of SPN creation, and required role assignments
- Security: SOC2 summary, data retention policy, KMS usage for keys (if applicable)
- Network: if private preview, single-tenant VNet notes, IP allowlist guidance
- Billing: sample invoice line-items, PO field mapping, remittance address
- Support & SLA: incident response contact, escalation path, runbook link

I'll attach publisher-evidence-checklist.csv and our internal marketplace-runbook link. Karthik, can you confirm if BitScale's workload (you said single-tenant VNet) will require any extra verification on our side?

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
